source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 15 (PDF 25-56), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Human Nervous System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Differentiate between nervous coordination and chemical coordination.
(Nervous coordination aur chemical coordination mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono jism ke kaam murattab karte hain; farq yeh hai.

book_ref.quote: In humans and other complex animals, there are two types of coordination

rows: Nervous system control karta hai
Endocrine system control karta hai
Electrical signals (barqi ishaaron) se hota hai
Endocrine system ke chemicals se hota hai

blocks.prompt:
2 Why is coordination necessary in animals? Give examples of coordinated functions.
(Janwaron mein coordination (rabta) kyun zaroori hai? Murattab kaamon ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Zinda rehne ke liye janwar ko mahol ki tabdeeli mehsoos kar ke jawab dena aur aza ko mil kar kaam karna hota hai. Coordination se har kaam, maslan dil ki dharkan, saans ki raftar aur hazma, jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Due to such coordination, every function is regulated according to the needs of the body

blocks.prompt:
3 Why are receptors called transducers? Give one example.
(Receptors ko transducers kyun kehte hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Receptors energy ki aik shakal ko doosri mein badalte hain. Maslan retina ke rod aur cone cells roshni ki energy ko nerve impulse (electrochemical energy) mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: rod and cone cells in the retina of eye convert the light energy into nerve impulse

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is the nervous system the most important for homeostasis?
(Homeostasis ke liye nervous system sab se ahem kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh doosre nizamon ko control karta hai aur khud bhi homeostasis (andaruni tawazun) qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: For homeostasis, the nervous system is the most important

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between Schwann cells and oligodendrocytes.
(Schwann cells aur oligodendrocytes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono glial cells hain jo axons ke gird lipat kar myelin sheath banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Two important glial cells are Schwann cells and oligodendrocytes

rows: Peripheral nervous system mein axons ke gird myelin sheath banate hain
Central nervous system mein axons ke gird myelin sheath banate hain

blocks.prompt:
6 What are nodes of Ranvier?
(Nodes of Ranvier kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Myelinated neurons mein myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm ke baad chhote non-myelinated khalon se toot-ti hai. Inhein nodes of Ranvier kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: These non-myelinated interruptions are called nodes of Ranvier

blocks.prompt:
7 What is a myelin sheath? Give its function.
(Myelin sheath kya hai? Is ka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Myelin sheath glial cells ki banai hui kai membrane tehon ka insulating ghilaf hai jo axons ke gird hota hai. Yeh axons par nerve impulse ki tez tarseel mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Myelin sheath is an insulating covering

blocks.prompt:
8 How are nerves formed in the peripheral nervous system?
(Peripheral nervous system mein nerves kaise banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Peripheral nervous system mein myelinated aur non-myelinated dono axons ikatthe bandh kar nerves banate hain.

book_ref.quote: both myelinated and non-myelinated axons are bundled together to form nerves

blocks.prompt:
9 What are Nissl's granules? Where are they found?
(Nissl's granules kya hain? Yeh kahan paye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nissl's granules ribosomes aur rough endoplasmic reticulum ke group hain. Yeh neuron ki cell body ke cytoplasm mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The cytoplasm in cell body is characterised by the presence of Nissl's granules

blocks.prompt:
10 Why do motor neurons and inter-neurons possess highly branched dendrites?
(Motor aur inter-neurons ke dendrites bohat shaakhdar kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke motor aur inter-neurons aik hi waqt mein bohat si mukhtalif jagahon se impulses lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Motor and inter-neurons receive impulses from many different sources simultaneously

blocks.prompt:
11 What is an axon terminal? With which cells may it communicate?
(Axon terminal kya hai? Yeh kin cells se rabta kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Axon ke sire ko axon terminal kehte hain. Yeh muscle cell, gland cell ya kisi doosre neuron se rabta kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: It may contact and communicate with a muscle cell, a gland cell, or another neuron

blocks.prompt:
12 Why are sensory neurons called unipolar and motor neurons multipolar?
(Sensory neurons ko unipolar aur motor neurons ko multipolar kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons unipolar hain kyun ke un ka sirf aik lamba dendrite hota hai (jis ke sire ki chhoti shaakhein receptors se juri hain). Motor neurons multipolar hain kyun ke un ke bohat se dendrites hain jo mazeed shaakhon mein bat-te hain.

book_ref.quote: Sensory neurons are unipolar

blocks.prompt:
13 Give the role of inter-neurons having short axons and those having long axons.
(Chhote axon aur lambe axon wale inter-neurons ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Chhote axon wale inter-neurons qareeb ke neurons se circuit bana kar chhoti maloomat parakhte hain. Lambe axon wale inter-neurons brain aur spinal cord ke mukhtalif hisson ke inter-neurons se jurte hain.

book_ref.quote: Other inter-neurons have long axons and connect with other inter-neurons

blocks.prompt:
14 What is a reflex action? Which neural pathway controls it?
(Reflex action kya hai? Ise kaun sa neural raasta control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reflex action bahar ya andar ke stimulus par foran, khud-ba-khud aur ghair iradi jawab hai. Ise reflex arc control karta hai jo sab se saada neural raasta hai.

book_ref.quote: It controls reflex action i.e., immediate, automatic and involuntary responses

blocks.prompt:
15 What is the response in the knee-jerk reflex, and which muscle is the effector?
(Knee-jerk reflex mein kya jawab hota hai aur effector kaun sa muscle hai?)
blocks.explanation: Effector ran ka quadriceps muscle hai. Yeh sukarta hai jis se ghutne par nichli taang seedhi ho kar aage ko jhatka khati hai.

book_ref.quote: It leads to extension of the lower leg at the knee

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the role of the inter-neuron in the knee-jerk reflex?
(Knee-jerk reflex mein inter-neuron ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sensory neuron spinal cord mein aik inter-neuron ko bhi chalata hai. Yeh chemicals nikal kar hamstrings ke motor neurons ko rokta hai, is liye taang seedhi hote waqt hamstrings dheele rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The inter-neuron releases chemicals which inhibit the motor neurons

blocks.prompt:
17 What is membrane potential? What causes it?
(Membrane potential kya hai? Yeh kis wajah se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell membrane ke dono taraf barqi charge ka farq (andar manfi, bahar musbat) membrane potential hai. Yeh musbat aur manfi ions ki mukhtalif miqdar aur un ki membrane ke aar paar harkat ki wajah se hai.

book_ref.quote: This difference in the electrical charges across cell membrane is called membrane potential

blocks.text: 15.3.1 Generation and Transmission of Nerve Impulse

blocks.prompt:
18 What is meant by a polarized neuron?
(Polarized neuron se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Woh resting neuron jo signal nahi le ja raha polarized kehlata hai: andar manfi aur bahar musbat charge. Is ki membrane potential (RMP) taqreeban –70 mV hai.

book_ref.quote: A resting neuron (not conducting a signal) is said to be polarized

blocks.prompt:
19 What is the role of the sodium-potassium pump in a resting neuron?
(Resting neuron mein sodium-potassium pump ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: ATP kharch kar ke yeh Na⁺ aur K⁺ ko un ki concentration gradient ke khilaf chalata hai: har do K⁺ andar, teen Na⁺ bahar. Is tarah andar bahar se zyada manfi ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Sodium-potassium pumps present in neuron membranes constantly move these ions

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har chakkar mein 3 musbat charge bahar jate hain aur sirf 2 andar aate hain. Yani har dafa aik musbat charge ka khasara andar hota hai, is liye andar ka hissa manfi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 What happens to Na⁺ ions during depolarization?
(Depolarization ke dauran Na⁺ ions ke saath kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Membrane ke Na⁺ gates khulte hain aur Na⁺ ions tezi se andar aate hain. Is se andar ka manfi charge kam hota hai; potential –70 mV se zero ki taraf ja kar 50 mV tak pohanchti hai aur polarity ulat jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This reversal of polarity across two sides of membrane is called depolarization

blocks.prompt:
21 How does the neuron membrane return to its original RMP after an action potential?
(Action potential ke baad neuron ki membrane asal RMP par kaise wapas aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thore refractory period ke baad sodium-potassium pump asal ionic taqseem bahal karta hai aur membrane RMP (–70 mV) par aa jati hai. Ab woh hissa agli action potential ke liye tayyar hai.

book_ref.quote: the membrane returns to its RMP i.e., -70mV

blocks.prompt:
22 Action potentials do not really travel along the axon. Explain.
(Action potentials haqeeqat mein axon par safar nahi karti. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh saath wale hisson mein dobara banti hain. Aik hisse ki action potential agle hisse ke liye depolarization ka stimulus hai jo apni action potential banata hai, aur pichla hissa RMP par wapas aa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In reality, action potentials (impulses) do not really travel along the axon

blocks.prompt:
23 Name two factors that increase the velocity of a nerve impulse.
(Nerve impulse ki raftar barhane wale do awamil ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Axon ka bara qutr (diameter)
2. Axon ka myelinated hona

book_ref.quote: The velocity is greater if the diameter of the axon is large or if the axon is myelinated

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is saltatory conduction faster than conduction in non-myelinated axons?
(Saltatory conduction non-myelinated axons se tez kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Myelinated axons mein action potential sirf nodes of Ranvier par banti hai aur aik node se doosre par chhalang lagati hai, myelin wale hisse chhor kar. Is liye yeh 50 guna tak tez hai (120 m/s tak, muqable mein 1 se 3 m/s).

book_ref.quote: In myelinated axons, action potentials are only produced at the nodes of Ranvier

blocks.prompt:
25 Define synapse. Name the gap present at a synapse.
(Synapse ki definition likhein. Synapse par mojood khala ka naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Synapse aik neuron ke axon terminal aur doosre neurons ke dendrites ya effector cells (muscle ya gland) ka jor hai. Darmiyan ka maye se bhara khala synaptic cleft hai.

book_ref.quote: The neuron or cell on the other side of the synapse is the postsynaptic cell

blocks.prompt:
26 What is synaptic transmission?
(Synaptic transmission kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Action potential ka synapse ke aar paar, presynaptic neuron se postsynaptic neuron ya effector cell tak jana synaptic transmission kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The movement of action potential across synapse is called synaptic transmission

blocks.prompt:
27 What happens to neurotransmitters after their action at a synapse?
(Synapse par kaam ke baad neurotransmitters ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh synaptic cleft mein hamesha nahi rehte. Kai synapses par presynaptic neuron inhein wapas jazb kar leta hai; doosron par enzymes inhein tor dete hain.

book_ref.quote: At many synapses, the used neurotransmitters are reabsorbed by the presynaptic neuron

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between excitatory and inhibitory neurotransmitters.
(Excitatory aur inhibitory neurotransmitters mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ka farq postsynaptic neuron par asar mein hai.

book_ref.quote: These neurotransmitters decrease the chance of transmission of nerve impulse

rows: Postsynaptic neuron mein action potential banate hain
Nerve impulse ke aage jane ka imkaan kam karte hain
Membrane ki Na⁺ ke liye guzar-gahi barhate hain
Chloride channels kholte hain; Cl⁻ andar ko RMP se zyada manfi karta hai (hyperpolarization)
Maslan acetylcholine, glutamate, biogenic amines
Maslan GABA, glycine, endorphins

blocks.prompt:
29 What are biogenic amines? Name any four.
(Biogenic amines kya hain? Koi chaar ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Biogenic amines excitatory neurotransmitters hain jo hormones ka kaam bhi karte hain. Misalein: norepinephrine, epinephrine, dopamine aur serotonin.

book_ref.quote: Biogenic amines are excitatory neurotransmitters. They also function as hormones

blocks.prompt:
30 Where is serotonin produced? Give any four of its functions.
(Serotonin kahan banta hai? Is ke koi chaar kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aant (intestine) mein (taqreeban 90%) aur CNS mein (10%) banta hai. Yeh bhook, neend, yaad-dasht aur seekhna, darja-e-hararat aur mizaaj control karta hai (rawayya aur muscle sukarna bhi).

book_ref.quote: It regulates appetite, sleep, memory and learning, temperature, mood, behaviour

blocks.prompt:
31 Give the role of GABA in the nervous system.
(Nervous system mein GABA ka kirdar batayein.)
blocks.explanation: GABA (gamma-aminobutyric acid) CNS ka sab se ahem inhibitory neurotransmitter hai. Yeh neural josh kam karta, bechaini, dabao aur khauf ghatata aur sukoon aur neend laata hai.

book_ref.quote: It reduces anxiety, stress, and fear, and promotes relaxation and sleep

blocks.prompt:
32 How do endorphins reduce pain?
(Endorphins dard kaise kam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Endorphins dimagh ke neurons se nikalne wale inhibitory neurotransmitters hain. Yeh dard ke paigham le jane wale excitatory neurotransmitters ka nikalna kam karte hain, is liye dard ke signals dimagh ke mutalliqa hisse tak nahi pohanchte.

book_ref.quote: They reduce the release of excitatory neurotransmitters responsible for transmitting pain messages

blocks.prompt:
33 Why does nerve gas cause muscles to remain contracted?
(Nerve gas se muscles sukre kyun reh jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acetylcholine skeletal muscles ko uksata hai aur phir acetylcholinesterase use tor deta hai. Nerve gas is enzyme ko rokti hai, is liye acetylcholine jama ho kar muscles ko zyada uksata aur sukra rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This inhibition leads to the accumulation of acetylcholine

blocks.text: 15.5 Basic organization of human nervous system

blocks.prompt:
34 Name the two motor pathways of the nervous system and what each controls.
(Nervous system ke do motor raaston ke naam aur un ka control batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Voluntary (somatic) nervous system: iradi (skeletal) muscles control karta hai.
2. Autonomic nervous system: ghair iradi muscles aur glands control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two motor pathways: (i) voluntary (somatic) nervous system

blocks.text: 15.5.1 Central Nervous System - Brain & Spinal Cord

blocks.prompt:
35 Name the three layers of meninges from outside to inside.
(Meninges ki teen tehon ke naam bahar se andar ki tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Dura mater (sab se bahar, moti, bari khoon ki naliyon wali)
2. Arachnoid (patli, darmiyani)
3. Pia mater (bohat nazuk, brain aur spinal cord se chipki hui)

book_ref.quote: Brain is enclosed within the cranium while spinal cord is enclosed within vertebral column

blocks.prompt:
36 Give the function of pia mater.
(Pia mater ka kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Pia mater meninges ki sab se andar wali nazuk jhilli hai. Yeh brain aur spinal cord ki satah se chipki hoti hai aur is ki capillaries inhein ghiza deti hain.

book_ref.quote: has blood capillaries that nourish the brain and spinal cord

blocks.prompt:
37 What is the corpus callosum? How are the two cerebral hemispheres related to the body sides?
(Corpus callosum kya hai? Dono cerebral hemispheres ka jism ki taraf se kya talluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Corpus callosum axons ki patti hai jo gehri naali ki tah mein dono hemispheres ko jorti hai. Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf se sensory maloomat leta aur usi taraf motor hukm bhejta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each hemisphere receives sensory information from the opposite side of the body

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between gyri and sulci.
(Gyri aur sulci mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cerebral hemispheres ki tah-dar satah ki khasoosiyat hain.

book_ref.quote: Ridges in cerebral hemispheres are called gyri

rows: Cerebral hemispheres ke ubhar
Kam gehri naaliyan
Wahid: gyrus
Wahid: sulcus
Naaliyon se alag hote hain
Gyri ko alag karti hain (gehri naali fissure hai)

blocks.prompt:
39 Give the functions of the parietal lobes.
(Parietal lobes ke kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Parietal lobes sensory maloomat par amal karte, jism aur mahol ki position ka shaoor dete, tawajjuh control karte aur harkat ki mansooba bandi aur amal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The parietal lobes process sensory information

blocks.prompt:
40 Give the functions of the temporal lobes.
(Temporal lobes ke kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Temporal lobes nazri yaad-dasht, zabaan samajhne aur jazbat ke liye sensory maloomat par amal karte hain. Temporal lobe ka auditory cortex awaaz ki mukhtalif frequencies se nimatta hai.

book_ref.quote: The temporal lobes are involved in processing sensory input

blocks.prompt:
41 What is the cerebral cortex? Name its three kinds of areas.
(Cerebral cortex kya hai? Is ke teen qisam ke areas ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cerebral cortex cerebrum ki tah-dar bahar wali teh hai jo grey matter se bani aur inter-neurons se bhari hai. Is ke areas: motor areas, sensory areas aur association areas.

book_ref.quote: It is densely packed with inter-neurons (about 10% of all neurons in brain)

blocks.prompt:
42 Name the three divisions of the brainstem with one function of each.
(Brainstem ke teen hisson ke naam aur har aik ka aik kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Midbrain: dekhne aur sunne ki maloomat aage bhejta hai.
2. Pons: cerebral hemispheres aur cerebellum ke darmiyan impulses le jata hai.
3. Medulla oblongata: relay centre aur dil ki dharkan, saans ki raftar waghera ka control centre.

book_ref.quote: Midbrain: It relays visual and auditory information

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between thalamus and hypothalamus.
(Thalamus aur hypothalamus mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono diencephalon ke do bare hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: Hypothalamus integrates the visceral activities

rows: Sensory maloomat aur cerebrum ke darmiyan relay centre
Andaruni aza (visceral) ki sargarmiyan jorta hai
Is ke do hisse jahan milte hain wahan pineal gland hai
Darja-e-hararat, bhook aur sairi, pyaas aur jazbat control karta aur pituitary gland chalata hai

blocks.prompt:
44 What is the limbic system? Name its parts.
(Limbic system kya hai? Is ke hisson ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Limbic system juri hui banawaton ka group hai jo thalamus ke dono taraf, cerebrum ke bilkul neeche hai. Is mein hypothalamus, amygdala, hippocampus aur qareeb ke kuch aur hisse shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: It is a group of linked structures

blocks.prompt:
45 Give the position and two functions of the cerebellum.
(Cerebellum ki jagah aur do kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Cerebellum cerebral hemispheres ke neeche aur peeche hai. Yeh muscles ki harkat (tez aur jaari harkaat) murattab karta aur jism ki position ki maloomat se posture control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It lies below and behind the cerebral hemispheres

blocks.prompt:
46 Give the location of the four ventricles of the brain.
(Dimagh ke chaar ventricles ki jagah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Do bare lateral ventricles cerebrum mein hain. Teesra diencephalon mein daen aur baen thalamus ke darmiyan hai. Chautha cerebellum aur brainstem ke darmiyan hai aur spinal cord ki darmiyani nali ban kar aage jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The third ventricle is in diencephalon between the right and left thalamus

blocks.prompt:
47 Compare the arrangement of grey and white matter in the brain (cerebrum) and spinal cord.
(Brain (cerebrum) aur spinal cord mein grey aur white matter ki tarteeb ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Spinal cord mein tarteeb brain ke ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: the arrangement of grey and white matter in spinal cord is opposite to that of brain

rows: Grey matter bahar (cerebral cortex)
Grey matter andar (H-numa ya titli numa hissa)
White matter cortex ke neeche (andar)
White matter bahar wala hissa

blocks.prompt:
48 Why is the spinal cord called an information highway?
(Spinal cord ko information highway kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke is par jism aur dimagh ke darmiyan paigham aate jate hain. Yeh neurons ki taar hai jo medulla oblongata se reerh ki haddi mein neeche tak jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Spinal cord acts as information highway

blocks.text: 15.5.2 Peripheral Nervous System - Cranial & Spinal Nerves

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between nerves and ganglia.
(Nerves aur ganglia mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mil kar peripheral nervous system banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Nerves are cable-like collections of axons

rows: Axons ke taar numa majmue
Cell bodies ke majmue
Brain (cranial) ya spinal cord (spinal) se nikalti hain
CNS se bahar hote hain

blocks.prompt:
50 From where do the cranial nerves arise?
(Cranial nerves kahan se nikalti hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke 12 jore hain. Pehle do jore (olfactory aur optic) cerebrum se; baqi 10 jore brainstem se nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: The other 10 cranial nerve pairs arise from the brainstem

blocks.prompt:
51 What is a mixed nerve? Name two mixed cranial nerves.
(Mixed nerve kya hai? Do mixed cranial nerves ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mixed nerve mein sensory aur motor dono neurons ke axons hote hain. Misalein: cranial nerve V (chehre ki hiss, chabane ke muscles) aur VII (chehre ke tasurrat, zabaan ke aage ka zaiqa); IX aur X bhi mixed hain.

book_ref.quote: Some of cranial nerves are sensory, some are motor and others are mixed nerves

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between the dorsal root and ventral root of a spinal nerve.
(Spinal nerve ki dorsal root aur ventral root mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Har spinal nerve in do jaron se spinal cord se nikalti hai jo vertebral column chhorne se pehle mil jati hain.

book_ref.quote: The dorsal root contains the axons and dendrites of sensory neurons

rows: Sensory neurons ke axons aur dendrites
Motor neurons ke axons
Dorsal root ganglion (sensory neurons ki cell bodies) hota hai
Ganglion nahi; somatic motor cell bodies spinal cord ke andar hain

blocks.prompt:
53 Give the region-wise number of the 31 pairs of spinal nerves.
(Spinal nerves ke 31 joron ki hissa-war tadaad likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cervical 8 jore, thoracic 12, lumbar 5, sacral 5 aur coccygeal 1 jora (8 + 12 + 5 + 5 + 1 = 31).

book_ref.quote: The 31 pairs of spinal nerves include;

blocks.prompt:
54 Differentiate between sensory pathways and motor pathways of the PNS.
(PNS ke sensory raaston aur motor raaston mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: PNS yeh do qisam ke raaste banata hai.

book_ref.quote: The sensory pathways contain the sensory neurons of spinal and cranial nerves

rows: Spinal aur cranial nerves ke sensory neurons
Spinal aur cranial nerves ke motor neurons
Jism ke receptors ko CNS se jorte hain
CNS ko jism ke effectors se jorte hain
Mazeed taqseem nahi
Do nizam: somatic aur autonomic

blocks.prompt:
55 Differentiate between the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems.
(Sympathetic aur parasympathetic nervous systems mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono autonomic nervous system ke hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: It prepares the body under physical or emotional stress

rows: Jismani ya jazbati dabao mein jism ko tayyar karta hai (fight or flight)
Dabao guzarne ke baad sympathetic asar ko ulat-ta hai
Motor neurons spinal cord ke thoracic aur lumbar hisson se
Motor neurons brain aur sacral hisse se; bohat se vagus nerve mein
Dil tez aur zor se dharakta hai; bronchioles phailte hain
Dil ki dharkan dheemi; bronchioles sukarte hain

blocks.prompt:
56 Give any four changes in the body when the sympathetic system is activated.
(Sympathetic system ke fa'al hone par jism mein koi chaar tabdeeliyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Dil tez aur zor se dharakta hai.
2. Khoon mein glucose barh jata hai.
3. Khoon ka bahao muscles aur dil ki taraf mud jata hai.
4. Bronchioles phail jate hain.

book_ref.quote: blood glucose concentration increases, blood flow is diverted to the muscles and heart

blocks.prompt:
57 Describe the structure of a taste bud in brief.
(Taste bud ki banawat mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Taste bud piyaz numa (bulb-shaped) hai jo baal numa receptor cells aur basal cells (naye receptor cells banane wale) se bana hai. Yeh taste pore ke zariye munh mein khulta hai.

book_ref.quote: A taste bud opens out into the mouth through a taste pore

blocks.prompt:
58 How does the brain create the complete perception of taste?
(Dimagh zaiqe ka mukammal ehsas kaise banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taste buds ke impulses cranial nerves VII, IX aur X se brainstem aur phir cerebral cortex ke zaiqe wale hisson tak pohanchte hain. Cortex ise doosri maloomat, jaise boo aur banawat (texture), se mila deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The cortex processes this information with other sensory information, such as smell and texture

blocks.prompt:
59 Name the three types of cells in the nasal epithelium with their roles.
(Nasal epithelium ke teen qisam ke cells aur un ke kaam batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Sensory (olfactory) neurons: in ke sire boo ke receptors hain.
2. Supporting cells: hifazat karte hain.
3. Basal cells: stem cells ki tarah purane neurons badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: These receptors are actually the ends of sensory neurons

blocks.prompt:
60 What are nociceptors? To which stimuli do they respond?
(Nociceptors kya hain? Yeh kin stimuli par jawab dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nociceptors dard ke receptors hain jo poore jism, khaas kar satah ke qareeb, free nerve endings se bane hain. Yeh shadeed hararat, bohat zyada dabao ya khaas chemicals (zakhmi cells se nikalne wale bhi) par jawab dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Nociceptors consist of free nerve endings located throughout the body

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between cold receptors and warm receptors.
(Thand ke receptors aur garmi ke receptors mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono thermoreceptors hain, yani sensory neurons ke nange dendrite sire.

book_ref.quote: while warm receptors are located slightly deeper, in the dermis

rows: Epidermis ke foran neeche
Thora gehre, dermis mein
Darja-e-hararat girna mehsoos karte hain
Darja-e-hararat barhna mehsoos karte hain

blocks.prompt:
62 Differentiate between Meissner's corpuscles and Pacinian corpuscles.
(Meissner's corpuscles aur Pacinian corpuscles mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono chhoone ke receptors hain jo capsule mein band sensory neuron ke siron se bane hain.

book_ref.quote: Pacinian corpuscles are sensory neuron endings, surrounded by a capsule

rows: Jild ki upar wali teh mein (hont, ungliyon ke sire, hatheli, talwe)
Jild mein gehre
Halka lams aur thartharahat mehsoos karte hain
Gehra dabao aur thartharahat mehsoos karte hain

blocks.prompt:
63 What type of receptors are the touch receptors of skin? How do they create the sensation of touch?
(Jild ke touch receptors kis qisam ke receptors hain? Yeh chhoone ka ehsas kaise banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Touch receptors mechanoreceptors hain jo mukhtalif jismani stimuli par jawab dete hain. Yeh impulses banate hain jo sensory neurons se spinal cord aur phir dimagh tak jate hain jahan chhoone ka ehsas banta hai.

book_ref.quote: They are mechanoreceptors that respond to different physical stimuli

blocks.text: 15.7 Effects of drugs on nervous coordination

blocks.prompt:
64 Define drug and psychoactive drug.
(Drug aur psychoactive drug ki definitions likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Drug: khurak ke ilawa koi bhi cheez jo bimari ya ghair maamooli halat se bachao, tashkhees, ilaj ya alamaat mein araam ke liye istemal ho.
Psychoactive drug: woh dawa jo dimagh ke kaam badal kar mizaaj, idraak, shaoor aur rawayya badle, maslan alcohol, caffeine, nicotine.

book_ref.quote: A drug is defined any substance (other than food)

blocks.prompt:
65 What are withdrawal symptoms? When do they appear?
(Withdrawal symptoms kya hain? Yeh kab zahir hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Withdrawal symptoms woh asraat hain jo nashai nasha-awar dawa chhorne par mehsoos karta hai, maslan ulti, sar dard, be-khwabi, saans mein dushwari, depression, zehni be-qarari aur dauray.

book_ref.quote: Withdrawal symptoms may include vomiting, headache, insomnia, breathing difficulties

blocks.prompt:
66 Why do withdrawal symptoms appear when an addictive drug is stopped abruptly?
(Nasha-awar dawa achanak chhorne par withdrawal symptoms kyun aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Drug ke istemal mein dimagh postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam kar deta hai. Drug band karne par dopamine ka nikalna normal ho jata hai, magar kam receptors ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam uksaya jata hai aur withdrawal symptoms aate hain.

book_ref.quote: When the drug is stopped abruptly, dopamine release becomes normal

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho receptors darwaze hain. Drug ke dauran dopamine bohat zyada tha, is liye dimagh ne kuch darwaze band kar diye. Drug chhorne par dopamine phir aam miqdar mein aata hai, magar ab darwaze kam hain, is liye neuron ko kam paigham milta hai aur insan bura mehsoos karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
67 Give the withdrawal symptoms and long-term health effects of nicotine use.
(Nicotine ke withdrawal symptoms aur lambe arse ke sehat ke asraat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Withdrawal: chirchirapan, bechaini aur shadeed talab. Lamba istemal cancer, dil ki bimari aur saans ke masail ka khatra barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Long-term nicotine use is also associated with a variety of negative health effects

blocks.prompt:
68 What is heroin? Give two of its harmful effects.
(Heroin kya hai? Is ke do nuqsanat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Heroin opium poppy se bani sakht nasha-awar opioid hai jo jhooti khushi aur sukoon deti hai. Nuqsanat: saans ka dab jana, infections aur zehni amraz (jaldi dependence ho jati hai).

book_ref.quote: It produces false senses of euphoria (intense excitement and happiness) and relaxation

blocks.prompt:
69 Give the effects of cannabis use, short-term and long-term.
(Cannabis ke istemal ke fori aur lambe arse ke asraat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Fori: sukoon, khushi, badla hua idraak aur bhook mein izafa. Lamba arsa: zehni salahiyat mein kami, saans ke masail aur zehni amraz.

book_ref.quote: The use of cannabis produces sense of relaxation, euphoria, altered perception, and increased appetite

blocks.prompt:
70 What are inhalants? Give two of their harmful effects.
(Inhalants kya hain? In ke do nuqsanat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Inhalants (maslan nail polish remover, glue) psychoactive cheezen hain jo khushi, sukoon aur badla idraak paida karne ke liye soonghi jati hain. Nuqsanat: saans ke masail, zehni kamzori aur aasab (neurological) ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: are psychoactive substances that are inhaled to produce senses of euphoria

blocks.prompt:
71 Differentiate between ischemic stroke and haemorrhagic stroke.
(Ischemic stroke aur haemorrhagic stroke mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono stroke ki qismein hain, yani khoon ki farahmi rukne se dimagh ka nuqsan.

book_ref.quote: Transient ischemic attack (ministroke) occurs by a temporary decrease in blood supply

rows: Dimagh ki khoon ki naliyan tang ya band
Dimagh ki khoon ki nali risti ya phat-ti hai
Rukawat band hone ki wajah se
Rukawat phatne ki wajah se

blocks.prompt:
72 What are vascular disorders of the nervous system? Give two examples.
(Nervous system ki vascular kharabiyan kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh woh halatein hain jin mein brain aur spinal cord ki khoon ki naliyan mutasir hoti hain. Misalein: stroke aur cerebral venous thrombosis.

book_ref.quote: Vascular disorders of nervous system are the conditions in which the blood vessels

blocks.prompt:
73 Name the infectious agents that can cause infections of the CNS.
(CNS ke infections paida karne wale jaraseem ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban har jaraseem: viruses, bacteria, fungi, protozoa aur flatworms.

book_ref.quote: Infections of the central nervous system can be caused by almost any infectious agent

blocks.prompt:
74 Name the two kinds of brain tumour and the risk factors for brain tumours.
(Brain tumour ki do qismein aur us ke khatre ke awamil batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Brain tumour benign (ghair cancer) ya malignant (cancer wala) ho sakta hai. Khatre ke awamil: radiation se samna, khandani tareekh aur kuch genetic mutations.

book_ref.quote: Brain tumors can be benign (non-cancerous) or malignant (cancerous)

blocks.prompt:
75 Differentiate between primary and secondary headaches.
(Primary aur secondary headaches mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sar ya gardan mein dard ya takleef hain.

book_ref.quote: Secondary headaches are due to an underlying structural problem in head or neck

rows: Khud sar dard ki wajah se, kisi aur sabab se nahi
Sar ya gardan ke kisi banawati masle ki wajah se
Maslan migraine, tension headache
Maslan dimagh mein khoon behna, tumour, meningitis

blocks.prompt:
76 What are functional disorders of the nervous system? Give an example.
(Nervous system ki functional kharabiyan kya hain? Aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Functional kharabiyan kisi zahiri banawati ya uzvi sabab ke baghair nervous system ke aam kaam ko mutasir karti hain, maslan sar dard.

book_ref.quote: Functional disorders are the conditions that affect the normal functioning

blocks.prompt:
77 What are degenerative disorders? Name any three.
(Degenerative kharabiyan kya hain? Koi teen ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Degenerative kharabiyan woh halatein hain jin mein brain, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke nerve cells dheere dheere kharab hote hain. Misalein: Parkinson's, Huntington's, multiple sclerosis aur Alzheimer's.

book_ref.quote: Parkinson's disease (progressive death or weakening of the neurons in brain that produce dopamine

blocks.prompt:
78 What does an EEG measure, and for which conditions is it done?
(EEG kya napta hai aur kin halaton ke liye kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: EEG neurons ke darmiyan chalne wale impulses pakar kar dimagh ki barqi sargarmi napta hai. Yeh dauron (seizures), mirgi (epilepsy) aur brain tumours jaisi halaton ki jaanch ke liye hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Its basic principle is based on detecting the electrical nerve impulses

blocks.prompt:
79 Give the uses of CT scan.
(CT scan ke istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: CT scans dimagh, phephron aur pait jaise naram tissues ki tasveer dete, haddi ki banawat ki kharabi pakarte aur cancer, infections aur chot ki tashkhees mein kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: CT scans are used to diagnose cancers, infections, and injuries

blocks.prompt:
80 Differentiate between CT scan and MRI.
(CT scan aur MRI mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono imaging ke tareeqe hain jo nervous kharabiyon ki tashkhees mein kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: This imaging technique uses a strong magnetic field and radio waves
